reviews.x: I cant believe I ever wasted my money at stores when I could purchase 4k of these for a fraction of the price. At Wally world were talking 3$ for about 75-100 of them, 4k for less then 10$ AND THEY VRING IT TO YOUR DOOR. Never again will i go into a physical store and purchase these.

I give these 2 stars. The amount you get for the price is ridiculously cheap and great and the rubber bands are very stretchy. However these suck!! I know clear rubber bands break under pressure which is why I use clear ones in my 7 months old hair but these break and fuse together so easily and I’m not putting them tight at all! I did 8 puffs in her hair yesterday and I’ve already had to keep replacing them probably within 15 mins of me doing her hair. The amount is great but I don’t want to ha

These are the best clear elastics. So many brands are so thin they break way too easily. I wore one in my hair for 3 days and it never broke. I will definitely be putting some in my purse for when I forget a hair tie. The pick is nice too. It works great for getting hair ties out of my daughters hair without it hurting. I 100% would buy these again. But there are so many, it just might be a lifetime supply!

I would definitely suggest these, and use them daily. The cutter is a good addition, but younger users should be careful not to cross hair between the cutter and elastic. I throw a few in my purse for those times I wish I had pulled my hair up.

I bought these to practice wedding hairstyles and they worked great for small sections of hair. I had put two around one large section and by the end of the day both elastics had snapped. But all the elastics around small sections of hair stayed put and I used the handy cutter to get them out. That cutter is great. It definitely saves on tangles! Just be careful. I definitely cut some hair getting the elastics out until I got the hang of the cutter. Well worth the money for the amount you get an

reviews.t: So useful! So happy with them!
reviews.x: Latex free hair ties are a real find! These are bigger than the rest, perfect for adult and children’s hair, perfect for curly hair and fine alike! Happy with my purchase! Each tie can be reused maybe once or twice, then they get loose. They look nearly invisible! Don’t knot in hair, but if they did the little tool supplied is super simple to use, a nifty idea and a great bonus.

reviews.t: Great for school mornings and nights
reviews.x: They are absolutely perfect for doing my daughters’s hair in the morning and I love that it comes with a tool to quickly and painlessly cut the bands out at the end of the day!

reviews.t: For dry hair without product only!
reviews.x: Completely fall apart and stick together in clumps when I tried using them in my daughter's hair after. I suppose they could work for hair without oil or product in it.
So Cheap! They Melt & Snap Apart as Soon as The Body Heat From Your Scalp Touches It!

reviews.t: Perfect! Very stretchy and strong for really heavy thick hair.
reviews.x: I use these on my daughters really think hair and these are stretch and strong! They hold her hair in perfect really high cheer hair ponytails and they don’t slip loose! The band remover has an actual blade in it to cut the band which as soon as I realized this, I have not used it again for fear of cutting her hair and not just the bands. They come out easily without the blade or pulling her hair out. There are so many, we shared them with some friends who’s girls also have crazy thick hair.

I really don’t love these elastics. My daughter is 3 and has very fine hair. I wanted to get the tool to cut her elastics so it wouldn’t rip her hair out when it was time to take down her hair. The tool is great, but the elastics are so stretchy that I have to wrap them around her hair more than double the amount I have to the goody brand elastics. It becomes a big deal when you have a squirmy toddler who doesn’t want their hair up and you have to keep wrapping and wrapping the elastics.

Fabulous hair elastics! They are the perfect size. You can do little pony tails or big pony tails with these. They stretch nicely without breaking. They aren’t cheap like most hair elastics. I love the elastic slicing tool. It saves my little girls’ hair from being ripped out and hurting. I have 2 girls and go through a lot of elastics. These are a great bargain. Durable enough to last all day without moving or breaking. I highly recommend these hair elastics.

[[VIDEOID:9cc9a4ae0d3a6400a48c04121bc94a17]] I love these I specially love the fact that it comes with a tool to get them out of your child's hair without ripping their hair out for somebody like me who does my daughter's hair every single morning it comes in extremely handy she had a lot of breakaways and now she does not you do have to be careful not to cut your child's hair instead of the band because the razor is extremely sharp obviously

reviews.t: Inexpensive but not always durable for hanging campaign literature
reviews.x: I used these elastics to turn campaign literature into door hangers by weaving two elastics together. Then I staple one elastic to the campaign literature and use the other to wrap around a door knob or door handle. Every so often, I have to replace the elastics because they break. That is no big deal because the elastics are inexpensive, but it is more work.

I love this product! I’ve been using it on my daughters hair and she has not complained that it hurts. The removal tool is very helpful since my daughter is 4 and can’t stand still. The rubber bands are great and thick. She can keep them and go crazy without ripping them out of her hair like others i have bought in the past. Would recommend this product!

reviews.t: Works well, but could be better
reviews.x: They are about the size of a quarter. They stretch just fine, not too tight if anything its kinda loose. About every 4th one (or so) will snap on you. Its good for pulling my hair half back (I have kinda thick hair) and it works well for tinier braids, you just have to loop it alot bc of how big the band is.

Gran cantidad de ligas de buen tamaño y gran grosor a un precio súper accesible. Realmente lo recomiendo, viene con un pequeño objeto para romper fácil la liga, solo ten cuidado a la hora de hacerlo, ya que podrías cortar el cabello también. Pero excelente calidad a un buen precio.  ;)

Ordered and came in good time and shape. They are a little bigger than what I’m used to using but unlike the smaller ones, these haven’t broken while putting at the end of a braid. The removal tool is very helpful as well. When I go through this order, I will be ordering this again.

These work well and are durable. Much better than the Goodie brand etc at the store. They stay put and don't accidentally break. My only complaint is that mine didn't come with the hook that cuts the elastics (so you don't have to pull hair out to get it out of your hair).

I’ve used them for different amounts of hair. My hair isn’t even that thick. These break crazy fast fast. I’ve doubled up to help and they still pull apart. No matter the amount of hair. I guess it’s a good idea that there are a ton of them and they’re not expensive.

Lots of sturdy clear ties! They are larger than your typical small elastic hair tie so they work great for large ponytails but they work for smaller pieces of hair too, you just have to wrap it around a few times more. The tool that comes with it is amazing!

The best thing about the pack is that there are 4k to make up for the multiple breaks throughout the day. In the future, i will be getting less that are higher quality so that i don't have to carry extras around all day to replace the breaking ones.

so far i like this product. i always have a hard time finding quality bands for my hair and love the little tool that comes with it.it was so much easier to get them out of my hair and my daughters without tearing our hair.. would recommend

reviews.t: The hair bands are really great and easy to remove.
reviews.x: These bands are super stretchy, and easy to use. They are also think enough to be durable for all day wear with kids that are very active. The tool is nice too. It gets our other hair bands that are not easy to get out, to cut out nicely.

I am a hair stylist of 15 years,  and I put wool dread tie ins in my hair! These rubber bands are the hardiest rubber bands I have ever used! I had my tie ins for 2 weeks and I replaced 2 rubber bands in that time! Amazing!

claims.text: Many reviewers find these elastics great value, praising the large quantity for a low price and saying they would repurchase.
The included cutting/removal tool is widely appreciated, especially by parents for removing elastics from children's hair without pain.
Several reviewers report the elastics break, snap, or fuse/stick together easily, especially under pressure or with product in the hair.
Reviewers praise the stretch and strength for holding thick or heavy hair without slipping.
Some note the elastics are very stretchy, requiring extra wraps, and can loosen after limited reuse.
